exposure: Stage of labor at emergency cesarean section (1st stage vs 2nd stage)
cohort: The study included 1229 women who underwent emergency lower segment cesarean sections at Al-Elwiya maternity teaching hospital.
finding: The 2nd stage emergency Cesarean section was associated with more maternal and neonatal complications compared to the 1st stage emergency Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Emergency Cesarean sections performed during the 2nd stage of labor resulted in more maternal and neonatal complications than those performed during the 1st stage.
